#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef int tf;
typedef int tc;
const tf INF = 1e9;

struct MCMF {
    struct Edge {
        int to, rev;
        tf f, cap;
        tc cost;
    };

    int n;
    vector<tc> dist;
    vector<tf> curflow;
    vector<int> prevedge, prevnode;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g;

    MCMF(int n) : n(n), dist(n), curflow(n), prevedge(n), prevnode(n), g(n) {}

    void add_edge(int s, int t, tf cap, tc cost) {
        g[s].push_back({t, (int)g[t].size(), 0, cap, cost});
        g[t].push_back({s, (int)g[s].size() - 1, 0, 0, -cost});
    }

    pair<tf, tc> get_flow(int s, int t) {
        tf flow = 0;
        tc flowcost = 0;

        while (true) {
            fill(dist.begin(), dist.end(), INF);
            vector<char> inq(n, 0);
            queue<int> q;

            dist[s] = 0;
            curflow[s] = INF;
            q.push(s);
            inq[s] = 1;

            while (!q.empty()) {
                int u = q.front();
                q.pop();
                inq[u] = 0;

                for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[u].size(); ++i) {
                    Edge &e = g[u][i];
                    if (e.cap <= e.f) continue;

                    int v = e.to;
                    tc nd = dist[u] + e.cost;

                    if (dist[v] > nd) {
                        dist[v] = nd;
                        prevnode[v] = u;
                        prevedge[v] = i;
                        curflow[v] = min(curflow[u], e.cap - e.f);

                        if (!inq[v]) {
                            q.push(v);
                            inq[v] = 1;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            if (dist[t] == INF) break;

            tf df = min(curflow[t], INF - flow);
            flow += df;

            for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevnode[v]) {
                Edge &e = g[prevnode[v]][prevedge[v]];
                e.f += df;
                g[v][e.rev].f -= df;
                flowcost += df * e.cost;
            }
        }

        return {flow, flowcost};
    }
};

int main() {
    int n, m, k, c, d;
    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;

    const int T = 150;
    int S = n * T;
    int TT = S + 1;
    MCMF mcf(S + 2);

    auto id = [&](int city, int time) {
        return city * T + time;
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; ++j) {
            mcf.add_edge(id(i, j), id(i, j + 1), INF, c);
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < T; ++i) {
        mcf.add_edge(id(0, i), TT, INF, 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        --x;
        mcf.add_edge(S, id(x, 0), 1, 0);
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int x, y;
        cin >> x >> y;
        --x;
        --y;

        for (int j = 0; j < T - 1; ++j) {
            int cur = 1;
            for (int _ = 0; _ < k; ++_) {
                mcf.add_edge(id(x, j), id(y, j + 1), 1, cur * d + c);
                mcf.add_edge(id(y, j), id(x, j + 1), 1, cur * d + c);
                cur += 2;
            }
        }
    }

    auto p = mcf.get_flow(S, TT);
    assert(p.first == k);
    cout << p.second << endl;

    return 0;
}
